notes.title: Preparation Patch
notes.content: A small patch introducing a checkpoint system, as well as a few continuity tweaks in preparation for the upcoming release of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2767740/Werewolves_3_Evolutions_End/]Werewolves 3: Evolution's End[/url].

notes.title: Minor Update
notes.content:
- [b]Save game function implemented in preparation for Werewolves 3: Evolution's End.[/b]
- If you decide to kill Tayla late in ch4, the game didn't set her as dead or pop the achievement. Fixed.
- Some places testing the Kotori relationship use capital K (ch6) all names in these tests should be lowercase. Fixed.
- ch6. Added parenthesis to all ch6_rescued_tiva toggles 
- In ch7, Kotori calls the werewolf World War 2 project 'Operation Meta'. Changed to Operation Lycanthrope due to Meta/Facebook
- Some tests in ch9 were unreasonably difficult. Made many a tad easier
- Typo, ch9. Havok instead of havoc. 
- In ch9, *goto crowbar has two quotes mashed together. Needed a 'she says' to join them. Fixed.
- ch9, line 1424 "scooping the container up from where Maker dropped it" Maker doesn't always drop container. Fixed.
- ch10 elder sequence. Mitena's breathing is 'labored' twice in a row. Fixed.
- ch10 "copse of trees" used twice next to each other in Maker epilogue. Removed second instance.
